reply.text: This is a general hydration question, and it touches on weight-making, which I'll keep to general context. Skipping water for a weigh-in is a practice I'd steer you away from: going very dry can leave you weak, dizzy and slow to recover, and it can make a weigh-in less reliable rather than more useful. Drink normally through the day and keep your usual routine so you're not chasing a number. If you're cutting weight for a competition or a fight, that's a conversation for a doctor or dietitian who can look at your specifics, and I'll keep building your training around whatever they clear. Is there a weigh-in coming up you're prepping for?
